test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a row on a wall facing towards the west. R is just to the left of S. Q is at one of the end points and T is his neighbour. V is sitting between T and U. S is fifth from the north end. Who among the following persons is sitting exactly in the middle of the row?
solution:
P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a row on a wall facing towards the west.

1) S is fifth from the north end and R is just to the left of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80b9eb68c5af4feccab02fcb9de8c82f28afa110b59ecac661e659797445bae8.png] 

2) Q is at one of the end points and T is his neighbour and V is sitting between T and U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07751b455a4e3da9cc09f16acbc5fe8bf5d2851503bc46bffefe3d0e83c2a23c.png] 

∴ Here, 'U' is sitting exactly in middle of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is** "U".**
